MATHEMATICS — MOCK EXAM #12
====

GRADE: Grade 7
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 50
   C. 49
   D. 14

2. Which inequality means “x is greater than 5”? (1 mark)
   A. x = 5
   B. x < 5
   C. x > 5
   D. x ≥ 0 only

3. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 11
   B. 121
   C. 122
   D. 22

4. What is 8 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 57
   B. 56
   C. 1
   D. 15

5. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 9 cm and 12 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 3
   B. 15
   C. 17
   D. 21

6. In the number 3543, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 4
   C. 400
   D. 10

7. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 25
   C. 5
   D. 26

8. Solve for x: x + 8 = 15. (1 mark)
   A. 15
   B. 8
   C. 7
   D. 8

9. What is 8 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 11
   B. 24
   C. 5
   D. 25

10. What is 4 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 32
   B. 33
   C. 4
   D. 12

11. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 6 cm and 8 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 12
   C. 14
   D. 10

12. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 42
   B. 12
   C. 24
   D. 36

13. Which fraction is equivalent to 6/8? (1 mark)
   A. 2/3
   B. 1/4
   C. 3/4
   D. 1/2

14. Solve for x: x + 5 = 10. (1 mark)
   A. 6
   B. 10
   C. 5
   D. 5

15. In the number 3143, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 400
   C. 40
   D. 4

16. In the number 3141, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 10
   C. 400
   D. 4

17. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 9
   B. 81
   C. 82
   D. 18

18. In the number 3541, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 400
   C. 10
   D. 4

19. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 170
   B. 13
   C. 169
   D. 26

20. What is 8 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 16
   B. 64
   C. 65
   D. 0

21. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 48
   B. 24
   C. 144
   D. 156

22. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 90
   C. 18
   D. 81

23. What is 8 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 17
   B. 1
   C. 72
   D. 73

24. Which list shows all factors of 6? (1 mark)
   A. 1, 2, 3, 6
   B. 1, 6
   C. 2, 4, 6
   D. 3, 6, 9

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
